# Veadotube script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (a `cb` method each, or `cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

![A Run Python code step in the action editor](../../assets/screens/actions-python-step.png)

## veadotube.changeState

Changes your veadotube avatar state, optionally only for some seconds.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `state` | The state's name. For Random, several names separated by commas, or leave it out for any. |
| `mode` | `mode` | Optional. Set, Push, Pop, Toggle, Random or Clear. The default is Set. |
| `seconds` | `seconds` | Optional. Seconds until it goes back. |
| `node` | `node` | Optional. A State Events node's name in full veadotube; leave it out for veadotube mini. |
| `instance` | `instance` | Optional. Another open veadotube by name or address; leave it out for the connected one. |

**Gives back:** The id of the state that was sent.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("veadotube.changeState", new { state = "surprised", mode = "Push", seconds = 5 });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.veadotube_change_state(state="surprised", mode="Push", seconds=5)
    ```

## veadotube.getNumber

Reads a Number node's value in full veadotube.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `node` | `node` | The Number node's name. |
| `instance` | `instance` | Optional. Another open veadotube by name or address; leave it out for the connected one. |

**Gives back:** An object with value, min and max, or null when it has no value.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("veadotube.getNumber", new { node = "hype" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.veadotube_get_number(node="hype")
    ```

## veadotube.getState

Reads which avatar state is showing.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `node` | `node` | Optional. A State Events node's name in full veadotube. |
| `instance` | `instance` | Optional. Another open veadotube by name or address; leave it out for the connected one. |

**Gives back:** An object with state, stateId, states (all names) and image (the state's picture as a data: address).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("veadotube.getState");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.veadotube_get_state()
    ```

## veadotube.isConnected

Checks whether Cuebot is connected to veadotube.

**Gives back:** true while connected, otherwise false.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("veadotube.isConnected");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.veadotube_is_connected()
    ```

## veadotube.setNumber

Sets or adds to a Number node in full veadotube.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `node` | `node` | The Number node's name. |
| `value` | `value` | The number. |
| `add` | `add` | Optional. true to add to the current value. |
| `min` | `min` | Optional. The lowest value of the node's range (give max too). |
| `max` | `max` | Optional. The highest value of the node's range. |
| `instance` | `instance` | Optional. Another open veadotube by name or address; leave it out for the connected one. |

**Gives back:** The node's value afterwards, when known.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("veadotube.setNumber", new { node = "hype", value = 1, add = true });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.veadotube_set_number(node="hype", value=1, add=True)
    ```

## veadotube.setPushToTalk

Turns push-to-talk (or another on/off node) on, off or the other way, optionally only for some seconds.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `state` | Optional. On, Off or Toggle. The default is On. |
| `seconds` | `seconds` | Optional. Seconds until it is set back. |
| `node` | `node` | Optional. A Boolean node's name in full veadotube. |
| `instance` | `instance` | Optional. Another open veadotube by name or address; leave it out for the connected one. |

**Gives back:** The value asked for (true or false), when known.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("veadotube.setPushToTalk", new { state = "On", seconds = 3 });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.veadotube_set_push_to_talk(state="On", seconds=3)
    ```
